prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A young woman stands alone in a minimalist studio setting, positioned slightly off-center against a seamless, pale gray backdrop. She has shoulder-length, tousled blonde hair and a neutral, almost pensive expression. She wears a light gray, cropped knit tank top with thin straps, paired with a long, high-waisted black skirt that falls straight to her ankles. The skirt has a subtle sheen and a few faint, irregular white marks, adding a touch of texture and visual interest.

A striking element is the presence of two vivid, neon pink spots of light—one illuminating her eyes and the other her upper chest—casting an ethereal, almost surreal glow on her otherwise muted appearance. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating gentle shadows and a calm, contemplative mood. A large, distinct shadow of the woman is cast on the wall to her right, adding depth and a sense of quiet drama to the composition.

The overall color palette is subdued and monochromatic, dominated by grays, blacks, and soft skin tones, with the only bold color being the artificial pink light. The style is contemporary and fashion-forward, with a hint of avant-garde due to the unusual lighting effect. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the subject while subtly blurring the background. The image evokes a sense of introspection and modern minimalism, with a cinematic, editorial quality.
